ecological_question: Does the earlier positive Beetle→Woody β-turnover signal persist after restricting to EXACTLY the eight source-coordinate-verified Terceira plots used by the new, negative Spider→Woody result? This tests spatial-subset sensitivity before inferring guild specificity.

original_event_cohort_frozen.how: Derive both sets by original Event metadata/author source site key, exact Spider qualified 8 original site identities and the original v1.299 Beetle 10-wide common method choice. Select no taxa or sites by beetle outcome, original source Event ID lexicographic order immutable.

original_comparator.caution: Same eight-site comparison is DESCRIPTIVE and post-outcome for both guilds. Never infer an independent confirmatory guild interaction from pairwise dependent dyads or cross-study score differences.

analysis.original_woody_response: Same original Woody taxon source names/ranks species/subspecies and plot Jaccard used in v1.308; baseline must reproduce EXACT 8-site v1.308 distance-only LOPO MSE to <=1e-10 or STOP. This locks target and original paired geography.
analysis.beetle_predictor: Source-author scientificName non-empty operational beetle taxon names as v1.300; collapse repeated detections within six source-selected original beetle Events of each of eight plots. Restrict no additional taxa after outcome.
analysis.model: Fixed v1.300/v1.308 ridge lambda 0.1 with per-training-fold x standardization. LOPO = 8 held sites, train 21 pairs entirely in remaining 7, test 7 pairs to held-out site, per-site equal mean squared error.
analysis.gain: Original eight-site geography-only LOPO MSE minus augmented geography+Beetle original eight-site LOPO MSE.
analysis.null: 999 source beetle PLOT-label permutations at seed 20261028, not pair shuffles; +1 exceedance rank and 95th percentile; unchanged seed, no rerunning for favorable sign.
analysis.minimum_source_quality: Original Tree Event/Occurrence and Beetle Event/Occurrence join fractions each>=0.98; all eight sites contain>=1 woody and>=1 beetle taxon, at least 6 sites each group have>=2 taxa, and >5 nonzero Jaccard pairs in each group; selected beetle occurrence unknown/blank taxon names <=5%; otherwise no effect score.
analysis.ecological_resolution: If beetle gain remains positive against geography on EXACT same eight sites while spider gain remains negative, signal may be guild-specific or method-specific within this ONE island; if beetle gain vanishes, original 10-site positive was subset-sensitive. Both remain exploratory, neither implies causal mechanism or island generality.
